examples.en: They have a beautiful home in California.

examples.en: Good luck in your new home!

examples.cn: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。
examples.en: I’m going to show you how to make a box for your tools.

examples.en: Everyone needs friends, and if you fail to make friends, you should examine yourself and see if there is something wrong with your personality.

words.meaningEn: on the day that is happening now

examples.en: I couldn’t go shopping yesterday so I’ll have to go today.

examples.cn: 埃德今天有音乐课。

words.meaningEn: the middle of a space, area, or object, especially the exact middle

examples.en: The builder designed a new shopping center for the company.

examples.en: Whatever is at the center of your life is what you worship.

examples.en: What do people do on the weekend?

examples.en: Carrying a sleep debt throughout the week with the hopes of paying it off on the weekend is a bad strategy.

words.meaningEn: to give lessons in a school, college, or university, or to help someone learn about something by giving them information

words.meaningEn: towards a higher place or position

examples.en: We walked slowly up the hill.

examples.cn: 她从地板上捡起外套。

examples.en: They have to get up early in the morning.

words.meaningEn: to clean something or make something smooth and tidy using a brush

words.meaningEn: used to talk about what happens on most occasions or in most situations

examples.cn: 戒烟不言晚。

examples.cn: 克里斯·凯利(吉他手)和本尼·海斯(键盘手和主唱)
examples.en: Chris Kelly (guitar) and Benny Hayes (keyboards and vocals)

words.meaningEn: a statement telling someone what they must do

examples.cn: 我接到的指示是亲手把包裹交给他。
examples.en: My instructions are (= I have been told ) to give the package to him personally.

examples.cn: 你一定要遵照医生的嘱咐。
examples.en: Make sure you carry out the doctor’s instructions.

words.meaningEn: to become twice as big or twice as much, or to make something twice as big or twice as much
words.meaning: 加倍；是...的两倍；两倍的；加倍的

examples.cn: 这座教堂的会众在过去的五年里增加了一倍。
examples.en: The church has doubled its membership in the last five years.

examples.cn: 该城被两倍厚的墙围了起来。
examples.en: The city was enclosed by walls of double thickness. ＃

words.meaningEn: used to say what you will do in the future

examples.cn: 我们下周要出去。
examples.en: We shall be away next week.

examples.cn: 我得当心。
examples.en: I shall have to be careful.

examples.cn: 我从来都不喜欢她，以后也不会。
examples.en: I’ve never liked her and I never shall.

words.meaningEn: to successfully control a feeling or problem that prevents you from achieving something

examples.cn: 他努力克服自己的羞怯。
examples.en: He struggled to overcome his shyness.

examples.cn: 她的经济困难再也无法解决。
examples.en: Her financial problems could no longer be overcome.

examples.cn: 澳大利亚队2比1战胜了荷兰队。
examples.en: Australia overcame the Netherlands 2-1. ＃

words.meaningEn: to do something badly

examples.cn: 很多人不会理财。
examples.en: Many people make a mess of handling money.

words.meaningEn: to obtain a degree, especially a first degree, from a college or university

examples.cn: 男孩们中学毕业后安迁到了佛蒙特州的一座小镇。
examples.en: When the boys graduated from high school, Ann moved to a small town in Vermont.

words.meaningEn: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with us

examples.cn: 我带你去你的房间，我们的房间在你的隔壁。
examples.en: I’ll show you to your room. Ours is next door.

examples.cn: 我们的大脑和猴子的大脑之间的主要差别在于我们的要大些。
examples.en: The main difference between our brains and those of monkeys is that ours are bigger.

examples.cn: 不，那不是我们的。
examples.en: No, that’s not ours.

words.meaningEn: having a higher position, level, or rank

examples.cn: 众议院委员会中的资深民主党人
examples.en: the senior Democrat on the House committee

examples.cn: 白人占据高级管理层的大部分职位。
examples.en: White men hold most of the jobs in senior management .

examples.cn: 律师事务所里的资深合伙人
examples.en: the senior partner in a law firm

words.meaningEn: the writing that forms the main part of a book, magazine etc, rather than the pictures or notes

examples.cn: 儿童书籍里不应该有太多的文字。
examples.en: There should not be too much text in children’s books.

examples.cn: 一些原始教材保留了下来。
examples.en: Some of the original text has survived. ＃

words.meaningEn: the amount or degree of something, compared to another amount or degree

examples.cn: 通货膨胀降至30年来最低点。
examples.en: Inflation fell to its lowest level in 30 years.

words.meaningEn: a unit for measuring temperature. It can be shown as a symbol after a number. For example, 70° means 70 degrees.

phrases.cn: 学士学位；大学本科学位证书

examples.cn: 把烘箱预热至425度。
examples.en: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.

examples.cn: 报纸重宣传轻资讯的程度各不相同。
examples.en: Newspapers vary in the degree to which they emphasize propaganda rather than information.

examples.cn: 荣誉学位
examples.en: an Honours degree

words.meaningEn: someone whose job is to manage part or all of a company or other organization

examples.cn: 我们的一位地区经理
examples.en: one of our regional managers

examples.cn: 一家计算机公司的中层管理人员
examples.en: a middle manager in a computer company

words.meaningEn: to feel that you can trust sb

examples.cn: 你可以信任这位姑娘，她决不会让你失望的。
examples.en: You can believe in this girl,she'll never let you down.

words.meaningEn: a polite word for a man, used especially when talking to or about a man you do not know

phrases.cn: [美国英语](美国众议院)某某州(选出的)议员

examples.cn: 巴思小姐，请你接待一下这位先生好吗？
examples.en: Could you serve this gentleman please, Miss Bath?

examples.cn: 早上好，女士们，先生们。
examples.en: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen .

examples.cn: 一位老先生在火炉旁边睡着了。
examples.en: An elderly gentleman was asleep next to the fire.

words.meaningEn: the time when you complete a university degree course or your education at an American  high school

examples.cn: 尼尔毕业以后回到了俄亥俄州。
examples.en: After graduation Neil returned to Ohio.

examples.cn: 南希毕业以后当了一名美术老师。
examples.en: On graduation (= after completing a first degree ), Nancy became an art teacher.

words.meaningEn: an important social or religious event, when a traditional set of actions is performed in a formal way

phrases.cn: 开学典礼；开幕式；开幕仪式；开幕典礼

examples.cn: 婚礼
examples.en: a wedding ceremony

examples.cn: 奥运会开幕式
examples.en: the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games

words.meaningEn: to tell someone that you are happy because they have achieved something or because something nice has happened to them

examples.cn: 他甚至没有过来向我祝贺。
examples.en: He never even stopped to congratulate me.

words.meaningEn: feeling that you want or need a drink

examples.cn: 我能喝一杯水吗？ 我太渴了。
examples.en: Can I have a glass of water? I’m really thirsty.

examples.cn: 他一直在花园里干活，又热又渴。
examples.en: He’d been working in the garden and was very hot and thirsty.

examples.cn: 这种挖地的活干了让人口渴。
examples.en: All this digging is thirsty work (= work that makes you want a drink ) .

words.meaningEn: a piece of work that must be done, especially one that is difficult or unpleasant or that must be done regularly

examples.cn: 萨拉的任务是准备会议议程。
examples.en: Sara had the task of preparing the agenda for meetings.

examples.cn: 我分配到生火的任务。
examples.en: I was given the task of building a fire.

examples.cn: 执行这些任务所需要的技能
examples.en: the skills required to carry out these tasks

words.meaningEn: a short distance in front of someone or something

examples.cn: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。
examples.en: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.

examples.cn: 我们能看到前方拉斯维加斯的灯光。
examples.en: We could see the lights of Las Vegas up ahead .

examples.cn: 亨利赶紧跑到前面。
examples.en: Henry hurried on ahead (=  went in front of the others  ) .

words.meaningEn: if someone is responsible for an accident, mistake, crime etc, it is their fault or they can be blamed
words.meaning: 应承担责任的；有责任的

examples.cn: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。
examples.en: We are determined to bring the people responsible to justice.

examples.cn: 警方认为该地区其他三宗谋杀案也是此人所为。
examples.en: Police believe that the same man is responsible for three other murders in the area.

words.meaningEn: not joined to or touching something else
words.meaning: 单独的； 分离的；分开；分离

examples.cn: 健身房和桑拿浴室在不同的大楼里。
examples.en: The gym and the sauna are in separate buildings.

examples.cn: 这样可以防止调味汁分层。
examples.en: This will keep your dressing from separating. ＃

words.meaningEn: one of the large flat parts that stick out from the side of a plane and help to keep it in the air

examples.cn: 那只鸟使劲地拍打着翅膀。
examples.en: The bird flapped its wings furiously.

examples.cn: 布莱恩：那么我可以穿我的游泳衣去办公室了？
examples.en: Brian: So I could wear my swimmers to the office?

examples.cn: 因此这次探险的第一个受害者是卢克自己，他决定离开。
examples.en: So the first casualty of the expedition was Luke himself, who decided to leave.

examples.cn: 对汤姆和特伦特来说，这只是个设置在舞台上的陷阱。
examples.en: For Tom and Trent, the trap demonstration was a setup on a stage.

examples.cn: 特伦特希望该技术可以作为一种开源的解决方案在公司间共享。
examples.en: Trent would like to see the technology spread among companies as an open-source solution.
